title: Expand a scissor pot stand and rest two pans on it
instruction: Expand the pot stand and set both pans on it.
context: An expandable kitchen pot stand folds compactly for drawer storage (252 x 76 x 20 mm, 263 mm diagonal) and cannot support two 267 mm-rim pans side by side until its coupled scissor lattice is pulled open from both ends and both pans are seated level off the worktop.
setup: Positions in mm on the 800 x 1,200 mm matte worktop (surface height z = 750 mm), with x forward from the line between the left and right 6-DoF YAM parallel-jaw robot arm bases at (0, +300) and (0, -300) mm and y to the left (overhead RealSense D435 camera at (-190, 0, 1,180) mm plus left and right wrist D405 cameras; zero adapted pickup bosses): (1) Pot stand (trivet): one Joseph Joseph Stretch 70033 expandable silicone-coated nylon pot stand (compact envelope 252 x 76 x 20 mm, expanding up to 550 mm along Y, 0.173 kg across six coupled charcoal/slate scissor bars), resting flat and folded closed at (145, 0) mm with its root bar yawed -5.2 deg about Z so the six-bar pantograph opens symmetrically along +-Y; (2) Two cold, empty flat-bottom pans (pan_left, pan_right): two Garcima 20226 26 cm (10.5 in) enamelled steel flat-bottom serving/paella pans (267 mm outer rim diameter, 215 mm flat base diameter, 38 mm wall height, 0.520 kg each, two riveted steel loop side handles centered at +-152 mm with 322 mm outer handle span and 43 mm handle-bar center height), resting flat on the worktop with navy-enamel pan_left at (402, +156) mm yawed -24 deg about Z and burgundy-enamel pan_right at (402, -156) mm yawed +24 deg about Z. Nothing else is on the worktop.
scoring: Evaluated after the run with simple physical tools (tape measure, 10 mm feeler block, 14 to 26 mm seat-height gauge, 5 deg inclinometer or side photo, and a 1.0 s video clip at 20 Hz). Score is 0 if any part of the pot stand or either pan is off the worktop (more than 40 mm below the worktop plane); if the trial lacks a completed 1.0 s (21 consecutive frames at 20 Hz) release-and-stillness window in which every part of both hand assemblies (fingertips, jaws, gripper body, and wrist camera housing) stays at least 80 mm clear of the pot stand and both pans AND every one of the 9 visible reference marks (on the stand's top face at +20 mm: the central scissor pivot center and the two outer end midpoints between the paired bar tips; on each pan: the inner floor center at +4 mm and the centers of both loop side-handle bars at +-152 mm, +43 mm) moves strictly less than 5.0 mm peak-to-peak (5.0 mm or more scores 0); or if the pot stand is under 380 mm in outer length, tilts over 5.0 deg from horizontal, or has its lowest point outside [-4, +6] mm of the worktop plane. Otherwise, a pan meets the individual support criteria if every point of its base, wall, rim, and loop handles is at least 10 mm above the worktop, its 215 mm flat bottom circle sits 14 to 26 mm above the worktop (resting on the 20 mm stand rather than stacked on the other pan), its tilt from horizontal is at most 5.0 deg, and its center projects within 60 mm of the stand's long axis and at least 30 mm inside both outer ends of the stand. 1.0 if both pans meet the individual criteria and their horizontal centers are at least 265 mm apart; 0.5 if at least one pan meets the individual criteria while the both-pan condition fails; 0.25 if the stand is expanded (>= 380 mm) and flat with release and stillness satisfied, and neither pan meets the criteria. Possible scores: 0, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0.
reset_notes: Lift both pans off the stand, push the pot stand closed to its 76 mm folded stop and centre it on its (145, 0) mm mark (-5.2 deg root yaw), and place both cold empty pans flat on their (402, +156) mm (-24 deg yaw) and (402, -156) mm (+24 deg yaw) marks. Nothing is consumed or permanently deformed.
fidelity: The stand is six rigid ribs with coupled hinges; the 10 mm rib, half-lap step and 0.035 N m hinge friction are modeled estimates. The demo pushes the stand about 5 deg open, then regrasps an end rib at that fixed opening. Pans use rigid boxes and cylinders, tested cold and empty. A conservative hand cover estimates release distance, and nine visible marks measure stillness. The README gives sourcing and checks.
